title: Stooq Historical Data API Query Parameters
description: Query parameters accepted by the Stooq Historical Data API endpoint at https://stooq.com/q/d/l/

s.description: Ticker symbol with optional exchange suffix. Covers equities (.US, .UK, .DE, .JP, .HK, .HU), currencies (e.g. gbp.v, eur.v), cryptocurrencies (e.g. btc.v), indices (e.g. spx), commodities (e.g. oil, gold), and bonds.

d1.description: Start date of the data range in YYYYMMDD format. If omitted, the API returns all available history up to d2.

d2.description: End date of the data range in YYYYMMDD format. If omitted, defaults to the most recent available date.

i.description: Data interval. d=daily, w=weekly, m=monthly, q=quarterly, y=yearly, 60=hourly (~9 months history), 5=5-minute (~1 month history).

apikey.description: API key obtained from the Stooq website via a CAPTCHA-gated registration form. Required as of early 2026.
